{{Quote|Then a fight broke out at Fort Klemark. The fort was destroyed and two hundred Republic soldiers killed. Eclipse went dark, and I've been tracking them ever since.|Elin Garza|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Fort Klemark''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] fort in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Klemark]] on [[Altair 9|Altair-9]]. When the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] unit [[Eclipse Squad]] went insane, the resultant fight at the fort killed two hundred Republic soldiers and destroyed the structure.
